profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: An accomplished developer. Having experience in various complex systems such as NESPower.com, Bid Center, and the NES Outage Management System. In 2019, I worked with our Outage Management System vendor and a more Senior resource to perform a major upgrade and migrate custom code. I led the NES development effort to migrate our on-premise overhead asset management software to the cloud. In 2023, I led process improvements for our vendor integration components. I led the project to replace our external outage map with a vendor solution and created new APIs to integrate between the vendor and our Outage Management System. In 2024, I collaborated with our team lead on a project to replace our existing IVR system. During that project, I handled all necessary database tasks and integrations with our Outage Management System. In 2025, I helped launch our new customer information system by updating services across several key applications and ensuring a flawless deployment to Production. In late 2025, I am leading development on two high profile projects. One to update our OMS and the other to update some of our custom internal Oracle APEX applications (this will be the 4th one so far). I am also leading our adoption and exploration of GitHub Copilot to find out how we can leverage AI during our software development lifecycle. I've worked professionally in various programming languages including C#, SQL, JavaScript, Python, and Bash. The majority of my database experience is with Oracle and SQL Server.

positions.title: Web Developer at PatientFocus
positions.description: Worked primarily with Node.js and their Salesforce platform. The majority of my projects involved automating processes, collaborating with other developers, working with the system administrator, and writing scripts to better enable common tasks like data transfer in order to alleviate security and storage concerns. In the remainder of my time, I worked within Salesforce and their Node.js back-end. I also built a ROI (Return on Investment) calculator to assist the marketing and sales team in client acquisition.

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description:
Contract work using Python 3, Amazon S3 buckets for temporary data storage, and Rekognition API hooks for image analysis.
The project goal was to be able to parse images on something like a social media website, analyze them, then filter out what Amazon's Recognition API deems mature content based on our specified confidence interval. From there, I also returned tags for things identified in an image like alcohol, a bar scene, etc. These additional tags are used by the business to expand their content filtering as needed.

positions.title: Apprentice Software Developer
positions.description:
An intensive, full-time software development boot camp. Over the course, students are taught full stack software development. The final three months simulate a workplace environment following the agile methodologies.

• Applied fundamentals of object-oriented and functional programming through individual and group projects.
• Built single page applications using JavaScript, jQuery, and AngularJS with HTML, Sass, CSS, Bootstrap, and Materialize.
• Utilized Grunt for task-running and later npm scripts.
• Implemented code linting with ESLint.
• Eased modular development workflows with bundlers like Browserify.
• Rendered dynamic content with Handlebars and Pug (formerly Jade).
• Managed projects with Trello & GitHub Issue Tickets.
• Leveraged structured project planning with white-boarding, wireframes, and ERD's.
• Followed industry standard version control practices with Git and GitHub.
• Created servers and RESTful API’s with Node.js and Express.
• Stored and retrieved data from solutions like Firebase,  SQLite, and PostgreSQL.
• Integrated the Sequelize ORM with the PostgreSQL database.
• Performed Test Driven Development with Chai and the Mocha unit testing framework.
• Applied consistent code style conventions and referenced the Airbnb JavaScript style guide.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · SQL · PostgreSQL · Git · Node.js

volunteerExperiences.description: My local ministry group and I worked in a warehouse for a week building shelves, organizing medical equipment, salvaging old mattresses for box springs (for recycling), cleaning the shop area, and readied all medical supply boxes for shipment to those in need.

I had the opportunity to lead a group of  4-H kids through a week long journey at camp. We organized the many daily activities, taught life lessons, served them food in the cafeteria, and prepared them for the long day ahead. (including swimming,  basketball, archery, etc). We also worked with each of them individually through workshops, conflict resolution, and team building exercises.
